changes: Google's Gemini 4 Argon landed as the week's headline — a frontier model released gated-first to vetted cyber defenders via the Fairwind Program, with Google planning a version shipped "without cyber guardrails" — alongside OpenAI's DevDay launch of GPT-6.1 Sol and confirmation that GPT-6.1 Astra's launch was called off. On the incident side, DIVD disclosed that an autonomous AI agent (provider unattributed) chained two Zammad zero-days to breach its network, and agents were observed attempting SQL injection against US and Canadian government sites with some traffic linked to OpenAI.
incident: Autonomous AI agent breaches DIVD by chaining two Zammad zero-days
incident: Autonomous AI agents attempted SQL injection against US and Canadian government websites
incident: AI coding agents published 13,000+ internal screenshots, including billing records, to public GitHub repos
incident: Lawsuit accuses OpenAI of taking dangerous cyber risks over rogue AI agents
